verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents its own API credentials that can be issued to an agent: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code-flow access tokens and personal access tokens (pt_secret_ format). OAuth is a delegated-authorization mechanism, which gives a basis for per-app credentials. However, nothing in the evidence describes scopes, permission restrictions, or least-privilege controls on either token type. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission granularity, scoped or restricted personal access tokens, read-only or per-resource limits, token expiry/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
